examples: Save your usual three-pane review setup once and restore it every morning.
how_to: Open the terminal widget menu, choose edit layout, and add a second session from the widget drawer. The name this layout box opens; save it and the arrangement is kept.
Bring it back later from the LAYOUTS section of the agents drawer.

media.caption: Naming a layout as a second terminal is added

name: Saved layouts
summary: save an arrangement of terminal panes and tabs and bring the whole thing back later.
